SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (gpa > ? OR (gpa = ? AND training_score > ?)
  OR (gpa = ? AND training_score = ? AND credits > ?)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outranking,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN class_code = ? THEN 1 END) AS class_total,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN class_code = ? AND (gpa > ? OR (gpa = ? AND training_score > ?)
  OR (gpa = ? AND training_score = ? AND credits > ?)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS class_outranking,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN major = ? THEN 1 END) AS major_total,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN major = ? AND (gpa > ? OR (gpa = ? AND training_score > ?)
  OR (gpa = ? AND training_score = ? AND credits > ?)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS major_outranking
       FROM semester_exact_rankings
      WHERE semester = ?

SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.endpoint, s.p256dh, s.auth,
            a.attempts AS delivery_attempts,
            p.events AS preference_enabled
       FROM push_subscriptions s
       LEFT JOIN notification_preferences p ON p.user_id = s.user_id
       LEFT JOIN push_delivery_attempts a
      ON a.subscription_id = s.id AND a.source_type = ? AND a.source_id = ?
      WHERE (a.subscription_id IS NULL OR (a.state = 'failed' AND a.attempts < 3 AND (a.next_retry_at IS NULL OR a.next_retry_at <= ?)))
      -- Recently confirmed subscriptions are more likely to be actively
      -- reachable. Prioritizing them keeps realtime delivery responsive
      -- without changing the recipient set, delivery key, or bounded batch.
      -- The matching D1 index is added in migration 0040.
      ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id ASC LIMIT ?

         FROM (SELECT * FROM course_filter_facets WHERE (semester IS NOT 'HK2_2026_2027' OR is_user_added=1 OR EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM hk2_catalogue_publications p
  JOIN hk2_catalogue_publication_receipts r ON r.id=p.receipt_id

WITH RECURSIVE facet_probe(value, step) AS (
    SELECT (SELECT MIN(r.major) FROM scholarship_snapshot_rows r JOIN scholarship_campaigns c ON c.slug=? WHERE r.batch_id=? AND c.status='published' AND c.public_data_approved=1 AND c.active_batch_id=r.batch_id AND c.revision=? AND r.major>''), 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT (SELECT MIN(r.major) FROM scholarship_snapshot_rows r JOIN scholarship_campaigns c ON c.slug=? WHERE r.batch_id=? AND c.status='published' AND c.public_data_approved=1 AND c.active_batch_id=r.batch_id AND c.revision=? AND r.major>p.value), step+1
      FROM facet_probe p WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND step<16
  ), facet_values AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT value FROM facet_probe WHERE value IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_probe WHERE step=16 AND value IS NOT NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT r.major AS value FROM scholarship_snapshot_rows r JOIN scholarship_campaigns c ON c.slug=? WHERE r.batch_id=? AND c.status='published' AND c.public_data_approved=1 AND c.active_batch_id=r.batch_id AND c.revision=? AND r.major IS NOT NULL AND r.major<>'' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM facet_probe WHERE step=16 AND value IS NOT NULL)
  )
    SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM facet_values) AS total,
      (SELECT json_group_array(value) FROM
        (SELECT value FROM facet_values ORDER BY value COLLATE BINARY LIMIT ? OFFSET ?)) AS optionsJson

INSERT INTO push_delivery_attempts
           (source_type, source_id, subscription_id, state, attempts, last_status, updated_at, next_retry_at)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?, ?)
         ON CONFLICT(source_type, source_id, subscription_id) DO UPDATE SET
           state = excluded.state, attempts = push_delivery_attempts.attempts + 1,
           last_status = excluded.last_status, updated_at = excluded.updated_at,
           next_retry_at = excluded.next_retry_at
         WHERE push_delivery_attempts.state = 'failed'
           AND push_delivery_attempts.attempts < 3
